librarygames/racer/Race.xtl

The racer's rules, a library: racer.xtl (scripted), play.xtl (the game: keys and the clock) and the web page all use these. Built on lib/Ecs: a world is a matrix, a row per car, and every rule is a system over every car at once. Your car and the rivals are the same kind of entity: the rivals steer for the next point of the track, you steer with your keys, and the rest (moving, the grass, bumping, the points passed, the laps and the places) is the same for all. A race's state is a tuple: (the world, the seconds since the lights, how it stands: 0 racing, 1 you finished, your place at the finish).

source · imports ec: lib/Ecs.xtl lib/Ecs.xtlm; sv: lib/Svg.xtl; t: lib/Text.xtl

The data

ʰw̲orld : Int -> Float

function (private) · line 21

The layout: where a car is (x then y, in tiles, y down), its heading (radians, 0 to the right, turning right as it grows), its speed, its top speed (0 for yours), the point of the track it heads for, the laps it has done, whether it is yours, and its paint.

"h" ᵉᶜc̲omponents< "pos:2 dir speed top next lap player paint"
ᵉᶜc̲omponents< expands to
ʰw̲orld ← { n → (n c̲at 18) r̲eshape 0.0 }
ʰp̲os ← { W → (3 4) s̲elect₂ W }
ʰh̲asPos ← { W → 0 < 2 s̲elect₂ W }
ʰs̲etPos ← { W (ids, v) →
  i ← r̲avel ids
  V ← (((t̲ally i) c̲at 1) r̲eshape 1.0) c̲at₂ ((t̲ally i) c̲at 2) r̲eshape v
  R ← f̲loat (r̲ange t̲ally W) '= t̲able i
  C ← f̲loat (2 3 4) '= t̲able r̲ange 18
  M ← 0 < R '+ '× i̲nner (((t̲ally i) c̲at 3) r̲eshape 1.0) '+ '× i̲nner C
  (W × f̲loat n̲ot M) + R '+ '× i̲nner V '+ '× i̲nner C
}
ʰd̲ropPos ← { W ids → W × f̲loat n̲ot ((r̲ange t̲ally W) m̲ember? r̲avel ids) '× t̲able 2 = r̲ange 18 }
ʰd̲ir ← { W → (6) s̲elect₂ W }

A new race: a car for each paint, on the grid behind the start line in pairs, all heading for the second point of the track.

ˡn̲ew ← { z →
  (W, ids) ← (ʰw̲orld 8) ᵉᶜs̲pawn t̲ally colors
  i ← f̲loat r̲ange t̲ally ids
  W ← W ʰs̲etPos (ids, ʰp̲air ((f̲irst X) − 1.1 × i, (f̲irst Y) + 0.5 − f̲loat (r̲ange t̲ally ids) m̲od 2))
  W ← W ʰs̲etDir (ids, 0.0)
  W ← W ʰs̲etSpeed (ids, 0.0)
  W ← W ʰs̲etTop (ids, TOPS)
  W ← W ʰs̲etNext (ids, 2.0)
